# Backstage vision canvas

Welcome to the vision canvas plugin for backstage.

![a preview of product canvas plugin](./docs/vision-canvas-example.png)

## Getting started
This plugin needs to be installed. Read up on [docs/setup](/docs/setup.md)

## Usage
Enrich your backstage system catalog definitions with additional spec.

```yaml
spec: 
  owner: example-team 
  domain: example-domain 
  sir/visionCanvas:
     vision: "
        - You vision"
     targetGroups:
        - "Your target group"
     needs:
       - "Put your needs first."
     productsAndServices:
       - "Your products and services"
     businessGoals:
       - "Get some value"
```
